consequence.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 removes support for karpenter.sh/do-not-consolidate, karpenter.sh/do-not-evict annotations and karpenter.sh/managed-by tag; environments using these must migrate to eks:eks-cluster-name tag and adjust taint tolerations from karpenter.sh/disruption=disrupting:NoSchedule to karpenter.sh/disrupted:NoSchedule.
consequence.remediation: Update all Node resources and workloads: remove karpenter.sh/do-not-consolidate and karpenter.sh/do-not-evict annotations, replace karpenter.sh/managed-by tags with eks:eks-cluster-name, and update any Pod toleration policies referencing karpenter.sh/disruption=disrupting:NoSchedule to use karpenter.sh/disrupted:NoSchedule instead.

original.statement: In Karpenter 1.0.0, the annotations karpenter.sh/do-not-consolidate, karpenter.sh/do-not-evict, and the tag karpenter.sh/managed-by are removed; karpenter.sh/managed-by is replaced by eks:eks-cluster-name, and the disruption taint key changed from karpenter.sh/disruption=disrupting:NoSchedule to karpenter.sh/disrupted:NoSchedule.

decision.reason: [ev-f83dc72c2c99] combines four separate changes under one "Manual Migration Needed" heading: Ubuntu dropped as a first-class AMI family, the do-not-consolidate and do-not-evict annotations removed, the managed-by tag replaced by eks:eks-cluster-name, and the disruption taint renamed. Each affects different environments and has a different consequence. The proposed migration-required consequence covers three of them and leaves out Ubuntu, so it is a bundle, not one assertion. Its remediation also adds details the evidence doesn't give (for example, that the annotations are on Node resources). The item should be split per change rather than given one consequence; three of the four proposers also said it bundles several changes.
